name: Gekokujo Selection Kanzen Han: Drama Shutsuen wo Kaketa Atsuki Yosen Taikai
original_name: 下剋上セレクション　完全版」〜ドラマ出演を懸けた熱き予選大会〜
overview: A behind-the-scenes docuseries following nationwide auditions, training, and set life for young actors vying to play the high-school baseball team in TBS’s drama Gekokujō Kyūji, from first qualifiers to the finale at Koshien.
